package.description: Free connectivity software for your graphing calculator.

en-US.description: Free connectivity software for your graphing calculator.
en-US.longDescription: TI Connect™ is computer software that allows for connectivity between a computer and graphing calculator. Transfer data, update your Operating System (OS), download Calculator Software Applications (Apps), and more to your graphing calculator.
en-US.name: TI Connect™

zh-CN.description: 适用于您的图形计算器的免费连接软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: TI Connect™ 是一款计算机软件，可实现计算机与图形计算器之间的连接。通过该软件，您可以向图形计算器传输数据、更新操作系统（OS）、下载计算器软件应用程序（Apps）等。
